name: N8N_CATALOG_SHADOW_MODE_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: N8N_CATALOG_SHADOW_MODE_20261107 — a shadow/dry-run lane is never labelled live because of one old apply.
jsonl-archive-rotate was FAIL_CONFIG on the live catalog: mode=live, in_relay=false, registry stage shadow with
dispatch dry_run and every ledger run dry_run. Cause: jobs_history keeps the last LIVE run, which is a one-off
manual --apply receipt from 11-03, and derive_mode read the mode off it. Fix: the registry decides — stage
shadow or dispatch.mode dry_run derives dry; an undeclared lane keeps its last-run reading; cron rows untouched.
